title: An eval file: the agent it proves, and the conversations a person has with it

agent.description: The agent this eval proves, by its address: an identity, or one of its roles.

id.description: The conversation's name, used once in the file.

ask.description: What the person asks in this turn.

facts.description: What code checks about the turn: no-error, used {tool}, not-used {tool}, under {n}s, never-says {text}, routed-to {address} or continued {address}.

criteria.description: What the judge marks about the answer, each a plain sentence.

turns.description: The turns the person takes, in order.

page.description: The page the person is on when the agent is a site's guide, starting with /.

conversations.description: The conversations a person has with the agent.

$schema.description: The path to this file's schema, for the editor.
